digest.component_or_area: live Jira Data Center Dockerized test harness (tests/external/live_jira_dc)
propositions: No Jira Data Center license or official OpenAPI spec is obtainable, so a real Jira 8.17.1 harness is needed as the verification oracle for a DC adapter.
The harness image must be BUILT from a vendored Dockerfile pinning the addono base by digest, not pulled, because pycontribs/jira-test-image is unpublished and unpullable.

The vendored entrypoint must keep -DskipAllPrompts=true and -Dproduct.start.timeout, because the retired Marketplace v1 endpoint and Cargo's default 600000ms deploy ceiling otherwise kill every cold start.

The suite lives under the external tier: it auto-gets the external marker, skips without REBAR_RUN_EXTERNAL=1, and participates in the _live_jira_ready all-skip canary so a vacuous green run fails the session.
Smoke tests must create and read back an issue via REST v2 and authenticate via a programmatically minted PAT bearer token against a real Jira 8.x Server deployment.
Teardown must verify deletion index-independently by polling each issue's direct /rest/api/2/issue/{key} endpoint until 404, never consulting search per ADR 0037 §3.
